title: Refugees moved as cargo in conex containers

tellings.quote: According to Barber, this is how they moved them. These refugees aren't being rescued, they are the cargo.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a claim from a man named Jake Barber, linked to a book called Sentinels of Ether, about events around 2004 near Coyame, Mexico. According to Barber, refugees were moved inside conex containers, the large steel boxes used for shipping, and they were not being rescued but were themselves the cargo, which would point to a hidden and cruel operation.
